opening.title: One app that needs to meet its market?
opening.line: Every week, on top of building it. See Traction in action on one of our apps, from its sign-up to its market.

chapters.label: replayed
chapters.name: Read
chapters.title: It reads your app like a new customer.
chapters.line: What works, what’s in the way and the move to make first, each from your own pages.

says.text: Three fields and a passkey. Nothing to install or connect.
Your board opens, and your Growth Manager starts reading your app.
Your first read: what works, what’s in the way, and the move to make first.
Each finding quotes your own pages, so you can check it.
The first move uses words your site already has.
Then your Growth Manager proposes the next step. You choose.

chapters.label: replayed
chapters.name: Customers
chapters.title: It finds people your app could help.
chapters.line: Businesses chosen from what their own pages say, each with the line it was chosen on.

says.text: One click starts the research: five prospects who may need your app.
It reads the web for businesses whose own pages show the need.
Five found. A public page suggests a fit; only a reply confirms interest.
Each with the line from its own site that shows the fit.

chapters.label: replayed
chapters.name: Email
chapters.title: It writes to each, in your voice.
chapters.line: Approve, and they’re in your CRM with their drafts. Nothing leaves without your click.

says.text: A first email for each, in your voice and signed with your name.
You read it. You decide.
Approve, and all five go to your CRM with their drafts. Nothing is sent without you.

chapters.label: recorded
chapters.name: Plan
chapters.title: Ask in a sentence. Get a plan.
chapters.line: The Growth Manager drafts the work to your deadline. It starts when you approve it.

says.text: Want more? Tell your Growth Manager in one sentence, with a date.
It comes back with a plan to your date, and waits for your yes.
Then it follows your app every day. Tell it what happened, and it works out what comes next.

chapters.label: market
chapters.name: Market
chapters.title: It keeps up with your market.
chapters.line: On Traction’s own board: one tile a day since its market read began, each story with its source.

says.text: Your market, one read a day. Here, on Traction’s own board.
One tile a day since its market read began. Pick a day to see what moved.
Each story with its source and the words it quotes, so you can check it.
And what changed since yesterday, before you choose the next move.

end.line: The trial lasts seven days. It includes a first impression of your website and one search for potential customers, with email drafts for the people you find.
